title: unbranded unit definition
description: The authoring contract for a unit, as written in a unit.json on disk or exported by a unit pack. The schema integer bumps on breaking shape changes; 1 is the initial published contract (F-14). File `src` paths resolve relative to the unit definition's own directory, which is what lets one definition move between the built-in catalog, a local units directory, and a published pack without rewriting paths. Distinct from catalog.schema.json, which describes the redacted public projection emitted by `unbranded list --json` and carries neither file sources nor option effects.

schema.description: The unit-schema version this definition is written against.

files.description: May be empty: a unit can contribute only dependencies, a package.json patch, or post-install steps.

recommendedExtensions.description: VS Code marketplace ids (publisher.name) gathered across selected units to generate .vscode/extensions.json.

excludes.description: Symmetric conflict; selecting either side blocks the other.

requires.description: Hard precondition; an error if any are missing from the selected set.

removeNotes.description: Printed by `unbranded remove` when the unit leaves residue its back-out can't reach. Guidance only; nothing is executed.

pinnedDeps.description: Exact versions only. A range would make two runs of the same unit produce different trees, which is the reproducibility guarantee recipes and packs rest on.

src.description: Path to the template, relative to the unit definition's own directory. Posix-style; must stay inside that directory.

content.description: Inline payload, for content computed at authoring time rather than shipped as a template file.

dest.description: Path relative to the target project root. Supports {projectName} interpolation.

rename.description: Replaces the filename `dest` chose, resolved against `dest`'s own directory, for a template whose shipped name can't be its installed name. Must resolve inside the target project root, the same rule `dest` carries: a `..`-traversing, absolute, Windows drive-absolute, or UNC value that resolves outside that root is rejected. Unlike a `/`-absolute `dest`, an absolute `rename` is never re-rooted under the project, so it escapes where the same value in `dest` would not. JSON Schema cannot express containment, so `unbranded validate` decides it by resolving the destination rather than by matching a pattern here.

key.description: Unique across all units, so a recipe's flat options map is unambiguous.

default.description: Must match one of this option's choice values.

optionChoice.description: Effects are overlaid onto the unit when this choice is picked: files append, dependency maps merge with the choice winning.

command.description: Binary plus args, run through the detected package manager's exec wrapper.
